examples.explanation: "aaa" is good; the full string fails since 'b' appears twice.
Every letter appears once, so no block qualifies.

hints: Any letter occurring fewer than k times in the current range can never belong to a good block covering that range.
Split the range at such rare letters and solve each piece independently.
A piece with no rare letters is itself good.
title: 470. Longest Substring with At Least K Repeating Characters
